collection.title: Toyota 4 Runner 1990 to 1995 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Toyota 4 Runner 1990 to 1995 model requires a 17" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
